name: Soccer Team
label: Dischord
lede: Two Dischord co-workers started writing songs in a basement in Southeast D.C. Nine years, a stretch in Flint and a husband on drums later, they had two albums on the label where they'd met.

eras.title: Made in the basement
eras.text: Ryan Nelson and Melissa Quinley traded songs between shifts at Dischord. The first album was recorded start to finish on 4-track and 8-track in Nelson's basement, and the label put it out.

years.h: Two Dischord co-workers start swapping songs
years.p: [[Ryan Nelson|758a01ba-b700-4b52-809a-917da0bb30e5]], of [[The Most Secret Method|9a6565fd-67d6-451f-8d1f-c006c9537193]] and [[Beauty Pill|976b28a1-dd68-4c43-ba08-ba15b58963b2]], and Melissa Quinley meet working at Dischord and start writing together at Nelson's house. Dischord dates the band to 2006.
Fourteen songs, all recorded in Nelson's basement studio in Southeast D.C. Nelson plays guitar, bass, keys and drums, Quinley plays keyboards and piano, and both sing.
years.xp:
[[Chad Clark|f3f09e99-e31c-4aa2-99e4-0b4e59e72f87]] of Beauty Pill mixed it at Silver Sonya, and T.J. Lipple mastered it there.

Titles run from Lobster Season to Johnny Hart's BC and Here's Why Dancers Smoke. Nelson and Quinley cut a new version of that last one nine years later for the second album.

years.h: On stage, Justin Moyer takes the drums
years.p: The band is mostly a recording project, but when it plays out, [[Justin Moyer|68cb15fd-5c0c-4b60-ad06-935ac0756a4d]] of [[El Guapo|be23bf0a-67c6-4b2f-ba2a-89d983f5ebdd]] and [[Supersystem|b900616e-fd32-4c17-8f77-17ae2f1413a0]] sits behind the kit, making it a trio.

eras.title: Flint, and back
eras.text: School took Nelson to Flint, Michigan, and the band went quiet. A three-song single on Lovitt kept the name in circulation, and in 2012 he came home.

years.h: Lovitt puts out a three-song 7" with a free download
years.p: Mental Anguish Is Your Friend, Letter To Saint Thomas Aquinas and World Series Apathy make up Soccer Team's 3 Songs. Dischord distributes it.
years.xp: Mental Anguish Is Your Friend comes back in a new version on Real Lessons In Cynicism four years later.

years.cap: Ryan Nelson singing and playing guitar at Comet Ping Pong, Washington DC, April 7, 2013
years.h: Nelson comes home from Flint and the band restarts
years.p: Soccer Team had been on hiatus while Nelson was in school in Flint, Michigan, according to Wikipedia. Back in Washington, he and Quinley pick it up again.

eras.title: Four people, one more album
eras.text: For the first time Soccer Team had a live band: guitarist Jason Hutto and drummer Dennis Kane, who is Quinley's husband. The second album took nine years to follow the first, and two of its songs are remakes of older ones.

years.cap: Soccer Team onstage at Comet Ping Pong, Washington DC, April 7, 2013
years.h: Jason Hutto and Dennis Kane make it a four-piece
years.p: Guitarist Hutto, of [[The Aquarium|99200bf8-65e3-4073-93f6-fb81a4078d61]] and Warm Sun, and drummer Kane join the live line-up. Wikipedia notes that Kane is Quinley's husband.

years.cap: Soccer Team at Comet Ping Pong for the Real Lessons In Cynicism record release, October 18, 2015
years.h: Friends Who Know goes out ahead of the album
years.p: The summer single is the first taste of the second record, Real Lessons In Cynicism.

years.cap: The four-piece Soccer Team onstage at Capital Fringe Theater, Washington DC, February 25, 2016
years.h: Nine years after the first album, Real Lessons In Cynicism
years.p: Dischord No. 182 has fourteen songs, including new versions of Here's Why Dancers Smoke and Mental Anguish Is Your Friend. Brooklyn Vegan calls it "high quality, traditional-sounding indie rock."
years.xp:
Brooklyn Vegan premiered Too Many Lens Flares ahead of the October 27 release and described the band as led by Quinley and Nelson. That same year Nelson's other band, Beauty Pill, put out its first album in eleven years.

Other titles keep the dry humor going: Problems With Prolonged Youth, Dinner With Derelicts, Vacations On The Lam.

sources.title: Brooklyn Vegan: Soccer Team releasing Real Lessons In Cynicism
